<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"><B>Item 5.02. Departure of Directors or Certain Officers; Election
of Directors; Appointment of Certain Officers; Compensatory Arrangements of Certain Officers.</B></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"><B><I>Appointment of Board Member</I></B></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">The board of directors (the &ldquo;Board&rdquo;) of Mobility Global
Inc. (the &ldquo;Company&rdquo;) appointed Joseph R. Hinrichs as a director of the Board, increasing the size of the Board from two to
three directors, effective as of 11:59 p.m.&nbsp;New York City time on June&nbsp;25, 2026. Upon his appointment, Mr.&nbsp;Hinrichs will be a
member of the Company&rsquo;s Audit Committee and Nominating and Compensation Committee.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">The Board has determined that Mr.&nbsp;Hinrichs (i)&nbsp;qualifies
as an &ldquo;independent&rdquo; director under all applicable rules&nbsp;and regulations of the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission
(&ldquo;SEC&rdquo;) and the New York Stock Exchange (&ldquo;NYSE&rdquo;), (ii)&nbsp;is financially literate as required by the rules&nbsp;and
regulations of the NYSE, and satisfies the definition of &ldquo;audit committee financial expert&rdquo; set out in Item 407(d)(5)(ii)&nbsp;of
Regulation S-K under the Exchange Act, and (iii)&nbsp;satisfies the requirements for audit committee membership established by Rule&nbsp;10A-3
under the Exchange Act, and has no material relationship with the Company (either directly or as a partner, shareholder or officer of
an organization that has a relationship with the Company).</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">It is expected that Mr.&nbsp;Hinrichs will be appointed as Chair of
the Board as of and following the effective time of the previously announced distribution of the Company&rsquo;s common stock by S&amp;P
Global Inc. (&ldquo;S&amp;P Global&rdquo;) to holders of S&amp;P Global&rsquo;s common stock on a pro rata basis (the &ldquo;Spin-Off&rdquo;).
The Spin-Off is expected to be effective as of 12:01 a.m., New York City time, on July&nbsp;1, 2026.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">Biographical information for Mr.&nbsp;Hinrichs is set forth in the
section titled &ldquo;Management&rdquo; of the Information Statement, dated May&nbsp;27, 2026 (the &ldquo;Information Statement&rdquo;),
included as Exhibit&nbsp;99.1 to the Company&rsquo;s Current Report on Form&nbsp;10, which was filed with the SEC on May&nbsp;27, 2026,
and such information and description are incorporated by reference herein.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">Mr.&nbsp;Hinrichs has no family relationships with any member of the
Board or any executive officer of the Company and is not a party to any transactions that would be disclosed under Item 404(a)&nbsp;of
Regulation S-K. There are no arrangements or understandings between Mr.&nbsp;Hinrichs and any other person and the Company pursuant to
which Mr.&nbsp;Hinrichs was appointed to serve in his role.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">Following the consummation of the Spin-Off, Mr.&nbsp;Hinrichs will
participate in the Company&rsquo;s director compensation program, pursuant to which Mr.&nbsp;Hinrichs will receive: an annual cash retainer
of $80,000, payable quarterly&#894; an additional annual cash retainer of $100,000 for service as Chair of the Board&#894; an annual equity
retainer with a grant date value of $220,000 in Restricted Stock Units (&ldquo;RSUs&rdquo;), which will cliff-vest after one year, and
a one-time RSU award to be granted in connection with the Spin-Off, with a grant date value of $400,000, which will cliff-vest after three
years.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"><B><I>2026 Long Term Incentive Plan</I></B></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">Effective as of 12:01 a.m.&nbsp;New York City time on July&nbsp;1,
2026, the Board adopted the Mobility Global Inc. 2026 Long Term Incentive Plan (the &ldquo;LTIP&rdquo;). The Information Statement under
the section entitled &ldquo;Compensation Discussion and Analysis&rdquo; contains a description of the LTIP. Such information is incorporated
by reference in this Item 5.02.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"><B><I>Chief Executive Officer Compensation Changes</I></B></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">The Board approved the following changes to the compensation of William
Eager, the Company&rsquo;s Chief Executive Officer: (i)&nbsp;an increase in Mr.&nbsp;Eager&rsquo;s annual base salary to $900,000, effective
July&nbsp;1, 2026, (ii)&nbsp;an increase in Mr.&nbsp;Eager&rsquo;s annual target incentive opportunity to 150% of base salary, effective
July&nbsp;1, 2026 and (iii)&nbsp;a grant of RSUs having a grant date value of $2,500,000, to be granted on or around
September&nbsp;1, 2026, subject to further approval by the Board, which grant will vest in substantially equal annual installments over
three years from the grant date.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"><B><I>Executive Severance Plan</I></B></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">Effective as of 12:01 a.m.&nbsp;New York City time on July&nbsp;1,
2026, the Board adopted the Mobility Global Inc. Executive Severance Plan (the &ldquo;Severance Plan&rdquo;). Pursuant to the Severance
Plan, if an executive officer is terminated without &ldquo;cause&rdquo; or resigns for &ldquo;good reason&rdquo;, subject to such executive
officer&rsquo;s execution and non-revocation of a release of claims, such executive officer will receive the following severance benefits:</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" STYLE="width: 100%; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top"><TD STYLE="width: 0.25in"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.25in"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Symbol">&middot;</FONT></TD><TD>(i)
If such termination occurs more than six months prior to or more than 24 months following a &ldquo;change in control&rdquo; of the Company,
cash severance equal to 1.5 times (or, in the case of the Company&rsquo;s Chief Executive Officer, two times) such executive officer&rsquo;s
annual base salary, payable over an 18-month period (or, in the case of the Company&rsquo;s Chief Executive Officer, a 24-month period),
and (ii) if such termination occurs within six months prior to or within 24 months following a change in control of the Company, cash
severance equal to 1.5 times (or, in the case of the Company&rsquo;s Chief Executive Officer, two times) such executive officer&rsquo;s
annual base salary and target annual bonus, payable in a lump sum;</TD></TR></TABLE>


<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0.25in"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.25in"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Symbol; font-size: 10pt">&middot;</FONT></FONT></TD><TD><FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">If such termination occurs after March&nbsp;31 of any year,
a pro rata annual bonus for such year of termination based on actual performance;</FONT></TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0.25in"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.25in"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Symbol; font-size: 10pt">&middot;</FONT></FONT></TD><TD><FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">18 months of subsidized healthcare continuation benefits;
and</FONT></TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0.25in"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.25in"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Symbol; font-size: 10pt">&middot;</FONT></FONT></TD><TD><FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">$25,000 (or, in the case of the Company&rsquo;s Chief
Executive Officer, $50,000) in outplacement benefits.</FONT></TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"><B><I>Annual Incentive Plan</I></B></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">Effective as of 12:01 a.m.&nbsp;New York City time on July&nbsp;1,
2026, the Board adopted the Mobility Global Inc. Annual Incentive Plan (the &ldquo;AIP&rdquo;). The AIP will govern annual bonuses for
the Company&rsquo;s executive officers following the Separation and provides the Nominating and Compensation Committee of the Board
with discretion to establish terms and conditions for such annual bonuses.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"><B><I>Legacy 401(k)&nbsp;Plan Supplement</I></B></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">Effective as of 12:01 a.m.&nbsp;New York City time on July&nbsp;1,
2026, the Board adopted the Mobility Global Inc. Legacy 401(k)&nbsp;Savings and Profit Sharing Plan Supplement (the &ldquo;Mobility Global
401(k)&nbsp;Supplement&rdquo;). The Mobility 401(k)&nbsp;Supplement is a deferred compensation plan that, pursuant to Employee Matters
Agreement, was carved out from S&amp;P Global Inc.&rsquo;s 401(k)&nbsp;Savings and Profit Sharing Plan Supplement (the &ldquo;S&amp;P
Global 401(k)&nbsp;Supplement&rdquo;) for purposes of administering deferrals made, and benefits accrued, by Mobility Global employees
prior to the Separation. The Mobility Global 401(k)&nbsp;Supplement will operate on substantially the same terms as the S&amp;P Global
401(k)&nbsp;Supplement, provided that the Mobility Global 401(k)&nbsp;Supplement will be frozen as to new deferral elections and employer
contributions.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"></P>
